tasks.label: Publish ShopNest to GitHub
tasks.command: git add .; git commit -m "feat: publish ShopNest Flutter ecommerce app"; git branch -M main; git remote remove origin 2>$null; git remote add origin https://github.com/haroon048/shopnest.git; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Initialize and push ShopNest
tasks.command: git init; git add .; git commit -m "feat: publish ShopNest Flutter ecommerce app"; git branch -M main; git remote add origin https://github.com/haroon048/shopnest.git; git pull origin main --allow-unrelated-histories --no-edit; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git checkout --ours README.md; git add README.md; git commit -m "docs: keep professional project README" }; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Push complete ShopNest project
tasks.command: git add .; git commit -m publish-shopnest; git branch -M main; git push -u origin main --force

tasks.label: Resolve README merge and publish
tasks.command: git checkout --theirs README.md; git add README.md; git -c core.editor=true rebase --continue; git push -u origin main; git stash pop

tasks.label: Complete README rebase
tasks.command: git stash push -m temp-tasks -- .vscode/tasks.json; git -c core.editor=true rebase --continue; git push -u origin main; git stash pop
